cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sell the signed guitar and we can replace the fridge. Please don't polish the signature; that's the part a buyer will pay for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I queued all night to get it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we photograph the autograph clearly and price it as signed, not as a used beginner's guitar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. The guitar stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The case didn't meet the musician. Keep it for the memory; let me list the object with the signature on it.
